Three induced colours on the Mobius ladder M_12: a refutation of the Lau-Shiu-Ng even Mobius ladder local antimagic conjecture

Myeongjin Kang

Abstract

chi_la(M_12) = 3 (Lean certifies the failure of the value 4; the matching lower bound 3 is an ordinary odd-cycle argument), refuting Lau-Shiu-Ng Conjecture 3.2 for even n >= 4; remark: chi_la(M_8) = 3 contradicts Lau-Shiu (arXiv:2203.06594, Acta Math. Hungar. 169 (2023)) Theorem 2.4

AI-assisted research preprint. The scoped main statement has a Lean certificate. Internal AI review is not external journal peer review; bounded prior-art searches do not certify worldwide priority. See the paper for exact qualifications and formalization limits.
